experiment_id.description: Unique identifier for the experiment run.

git_commit.description: Current git commit hash, if available.

model.description: The name of the primary model architecture (e.g. 'lightgbm', 'ensemble').

model_version.description: Semantic versioning or tags for the model.

feature_version.description: Identifier for the feature engineering pipeline used.

feature_count.description: Number of features passed to the model.

cv_folds.description: Number of folds used in cross validation.

training_metrics.description: Metrics evaluated on the training subset.

validation_metrics.description: Metrics evaluated on the validation (OOF) subset.

oof_metrics.description: Overall out-of-fold metrics across all CV folds.

generalization_gap.description: Diagnostic gap between training and validation metrics.

ensemble_information.description: Weights and base models if this is an ensemble run.
